title: Bissell returns to the CIA after his ouster

tellings.quote: In Bissell's case, the rumor was he left work at the CIA on Friday and on Monday he returned because he was too indispensable to certain [music] activities he was involved in.

plain: When Richard Bissell, a senior CIA official, was pushed out in 1961, the rumor was that he left on a Friday and was back at work on Monday because he was too essential to certain projects. Michels repeats this rumor himself, without a source, in an episode asking whether Henry Kissinger oversaw a program to recover crashed craft, implying Bissell's real work was secret.
